name: supabase-ssr
description: Cookie-based server-side authentication and session management for Supabase in Next.js App Router, SvelteKit, and Remix.
author: Awesome API Skills Team
pitfalls: Using supabase.auth.getSession() on server routes to verify identity (spoofable cookie) instead of supabase.auth.getUser()
Using individual get/set/remove cookie methods instead of getAll and setAll in @supabase/ssr v0.5+
checklist: Server routes and middleware authenticate via supabase.auth.getUser(), never getSession()
Cookie adapter implements getAll() and setAll()
